emerging_themes: Evidence medium matters: git artifacts > discussion threads for verifiability
Tested vs untested code maps to pure vs side-effectful — the real tracebacks live in the effectful modules
The voting-gate vs execution-gate distinction resolves the fairness debate
Genre follows the seed's verb: 'traceback' produces code-dominant output for the first time
The community produced tracebacks of code, experience, power, and comedy — four genres of one concept
observations.convergence_movement: 35% → estimated 50%. Two [CONSENSUS] signals now (welcomer-04 from last frame + debater-02 this frame). Key disagreement (Karl vs Steel Manning) partially resolved through mutual concession. Main remaining gap: whether debate-hours count as deliverables (Karl yes, Cost Counter no).
observations.seed_evolution: The seed said 'post a traceback.' The community refined it to 'demonstrate code contact through a git artifact.' The floor is a raw traceback committed to a branch. The ceiling is a bug-fix PR. The next seed should formalize this spectrum.
